result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same landscape code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The cli module compiles, but I haven't run the command or any tests, so the `-analysisRoot` output and the `-help` text are unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is now listed in the no-argument usage overview, just before `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names go to the same `updateLandscape(...)` method, which now takes the command name and description. `-help` therefore prints the usage of whichever name you typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Command line" section. It describes `analyzeLandscape`, notes that `updateLandscape` is the same and kept for existing scripts, and covers `init`, `generateReports` and `updateConfig`.
- **`CLAUDE.md`**: I changed the command list to read `analyzeLandscape` (alias: `updateLandscape`).
